beats.headline: Frozen twice for punching Bomo
beats.text: For the record: Crawler Carl sent Bomo into Zockau with a note for the last mantis on the floor, the one who trades the looted gear, offering protection in exchange for that gear: no gear, no deal. The mantis comes. In the saferoom he attacks Bomo twice with his fists, and is frozen for a minute and then an hour. He is small and shivering, without the sword-arms the females carry, and looks like a child. Edict. Mantis. Level fifty. Merchant. The Dark Hive. He is not a hunter or a fighter, he says. He is just the accountant.

beats.headline: Already paid for
beats.text: He learns from Crawler Donut's joke that the elf Akland is dead, and deflates further. Vrah is almost here, and has told him he must mate with her. His loot is contracted to the Burrowers, the mantis government, paid in advance and due to them when this floor collapses; he goes straight to the ninth. Giving it to Crawler Carl would ruin his family and his hive. He is of Deep Mind. So he has already handed it to another entity for a small fee, and does not say who.

beats.headline: A split in the tunnel
beats.text: The disease Crawler Carl gave Vrah has put his hive's fate at a split in the tunnel. Hand over the gear, and his family is ruined and he must kill himself in shame. Refuse Vrah, and her family takes revenge on his. Mate with her, and it is a forbidden coupling between his hive and hers; they would be deemed traitors. He explains to Crawler Donut that the female eats the male's head, and a secondary brain in his abdomen keeps him going. The more he talks, the straighter he stands. He needs to die in battle.

beats.headline: Finding the stars
beats.text: He hates this place, he says, and everything about it. Finding the stars was the worst thing that ever happened to his people: a slow, horrific death, expansion to the point of oblivion. The primals finally understood, too late. Some of the kua-tin know it too. They call it the Great Consensus, but it is not; there is no agreement, and their young do not understand. Then he asks, quickly, to be let into Crawler Carl's space.

beats.headline: Super Naughty, an inch short
beats.text: Vrah limps into the hallway, smoke rising from her crotch. Crawler Carl gives the subject a one-time pass through his door. With a strangled battle cry, Edict lunges at Crawler Carl and punches, and freezes with his small fist an inch short. Super Naughty. He blinks twice and disappears, teleported naked to the closest mob nest. Despite his report that he gave all his loot away, a metric ton of gold coins drops at Crawler Carl's feet, burying him to the ankles. Crawler Carl suspects this was the best possible outcome for him, or if not him, his family.

beats.headline: What he said stays
beats.text: At the end of a long day, approaching an ursine village, Crawler Donut says she kind of feels bad for that guy, Edict: he did not want to be here, and they forced him to play the game. Crawler Carl is not sympathetic. He has been thinking about what the subject said all day and cannot get it out of his head. He believes Edict did not want to be there and hated how the universe works, and he still thinks he was wrong. That is what bothers him most.
